svg.title: Light-clock time dilation
svg.desc: The same photon emission, reflection, and return are shown in the clock rest frame and a frame where the clock moves at 0.6c. The moving mirrors and the light positions obey the Lorentz transformation. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A moving light clock takes longer between the same events
Clock rest frame
Frame moving relative to the clock
Δτ (D/c)
Δt (D/c)
Mirror spacing D is transverse to motion. Both photons move at c in their respective frames; the
ground-frame mirrors move with the clock. Δt = γΔτ.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
